description:
Flared floor-length skirt with dense floral embroidery at the hem, scattered floral butis, and a scalloped embroidered border.
Includes: skirt, strapless blouse, and sheer net dupatta with embroidered border and butis.

work.placement: lehenga hem, skirt body, blouse, dupatta border and body
